facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Riga's Old Town, with a direct view of the Latvian National Opera House.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is nestled in the heart of the Old Town of the capital with a direct view of the legendary Latvian National Opera House.

facts.text: The House of the Blackheads is listed 0.6 km from the hotel.
The Freedom Monument is listed 0.3 km from the hotel.
Riga International Airport is 9 km from the hotel.
Riga Central Train and Bus Stations are 600 m from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Riga Central Train & Bus Stations (600 m)

facts.text: Pets stay for a supplement of EUR 55 per night, which covers the hotel's pet amenities.
facts.excerpt: And for a small supplement of EUR 55 per night, the guest's beloved pet can enjoy all these perks and more.

facts.text: A dog-approved menu is available in the hotel's restaurants and for in-room dining.
facts.excerpt: our culinary experts have curated a special dog-approved menu, available both in our restaurants and for in-room dining.

facts.text: The hotel can organise a bespoke hotel tour for children, based on the child's age and interests.
facts.excerpt: we will gladly organise a bespoke hotel tour based on your child's age and interests.

facts.text: The children's hotel tour finishes with a cocoa drink in the Lobby Lounge.
facts.excerpt: The tour will finish with a cocoa drink in the luxurious Lobby Lounge

facts.text: Olympic Casino at the hotel offers table games, slot machines and sports betting.
facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy a selection of table games and slot machines, along with convenient sports betting services.

facts.text: Guests are welcomed by the Lady & Gentleman in Red, a host dressed in red with knowledge of the hotel and the local area.
facts.excerpt: Dressed in striking red, this impeccable host has unrivalled knowledge about the hotel and the local area.

facts.text: The concierge can help with opera or ballet tickets, restaurant reservations and private jets.
facts.excerpt: Whether looking for opera or ballet tickets, restaurant table reservations, private jets or last-minute gifts, our concierge will take care of every detail
